answer.text:

Calculation: \((15{,}864 - 14{,}216) \div 14{,}216 \times 100 \approx 11.6\%\), rounded to **12%**.

Source: Adobe 10-K, accession **0000796343-25-000004**, “Segments,” chunk **839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b**.
